adjudication.rationale: In spec/models/topic_embed_spec.rb the "Supports updating the post" example only asserts `post.cooked` matches the new contents. The implementation in TopicEmbed.import has nontrivial branching: it reuses an existing TopicEmbed (`embed = TopicEmbed.where(embed_url: url).first`), conditionally revises the post only when `content_sha1` changes, and updates `embed.content_sha1` via `update_column`. The spec does not verify that the existing TopicEmbed row is reused (no duplicate), that `content_sha1` is updated on change, or that identical content skips revision.
